description: exp_g_0019 - the RESIDUAL ablation of exp_g_0018_smallE_concat. Identical in every respect except layer_combine: 'concat' -> 'residual_sum'. The additive skip is restored (x_next = x_flat + out_e, exp103's original single residual stream) while the CONCAT READOUT is kept: each layer's output is still stashed and all 6 are concatenated at the end -> LayerNorm(384) -> UNTIED Linear(384 -> 32768). Paired with exp_g_0018 this separates the two things that changed together: 'small E + concat readout' (shared by both arms) vs 'no residual' (0018 only). E=64, d_qk=64, d_v=16, interior H*d_v=96, out_proj 96->64, inner_in=48, 6 layers, seq 512, vocab 32768, 24,576 tok/step, 16,000 steps. train.py is byte-identical to exp_g_0018's; the arms differ ONLY in config.json. Shared lutorch NOT modified.
